text:
Jen: Heads up — we need a clear rule for when we persist full request/response payloads to help debug quota/exhaustion spikes. inspect-mode is too coarse and dumps PII.
Alice: +1. I'm proposing an "audit_mode: on_failure" that only captures full payloads when route hits quota_exhaustion or 5xx. reduces noise/cost.
Alice: example config:
```
route:
  audit_on: [quota_exhaustion, 5xx, manual]
  per_tenant_daily_capture_limit: 50
  debounce_window_ms: 60000
```
Mike: Security note — any capture must be KMS-encrypted at rest, access gated via breakglass with 2FA, and recorded in audit logs. retention default 30d.
Sam: From Console POV we need to show capture_reason and timestamp, plus a compact preview (redacted) and an explicit 'request full payload' button behind RBAC.
Jen: capture_reason values: quota_exhaustion|canary|manual. store model+route snapshot and hashed tenant_id (sha256) alongside capture. keep raw only in KMS-wrapped store.
ops-oncall: Concern: sudden blips can generate lots of captures. we need a global circuit breaker and per-tenant cap. maybe a token-bucket with emergency fallback to drop captures.
Alice: Plan: default OFF. per-route policy opt-in. per-tenant cap=50/day, global emergency cap and graceful degrade. persistence path -> encrypted blobstore + metadata record.
Mike: Redaction pipeline: run PII-scrubber with confidence threshold (0.8), but keep deterministic pseudonymized fingerprints for repro. store scrub rules version.
Yusuf: Can we hook this into telemetry? add metric 'redwood_audit_captures_total{reason,tenant,route}' and a heatmap in Console. also emit capture_size_bytes.
deploy-bot: canary-audit-rollout started on cluster-a at 1770002240 :rocket:
Sam: UX Q — add a 'Request Capture' CTA in route details to allow manual capture (with approval flow)? SEs ask for it.
Mike: Manual capture must require 2FA confirmation + owner notification + 7d retention min for investigations.
Jen: Next steps: Alice to prototype API+config; Mike to own encryption & scrub rules; Yusuf to add metrics & quota enforcement; Sam to mock Console flow. Sync Thurs 10am. :calendar:
Alice: I'll post a PR draft tomorrow. :thumbsup:
